mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 58 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library under a waning crescent moon. Tonight, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 48 degrees, and there is no rain expected.

The Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This new roadmap replaces the old plan and focuses on long-term goals like creating diverse housing, supporting our local business environment, and promoting sustainable land use through 2036.

There is plenty happening in Verona. Today, stop by Insight Wellness for yoga, visit Art House 360 for their Thursday night event, or test your knowledge at Hop Haus trivia. Tomorrow, catch live music at Bailey's Run or Lake Lou-ee, and on October 10, head to Century School Park for the Puppets in the Park festival.

On September 28, Verona police responded to a crash at Enterprise Drive and East Verona Avenue involving a 16-year-old operating an eMoto in a reckless manner, resulting in several citations for the juvenile.
The flavor of the day is double strawberry. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
